targets.summary: The permute dims parameter should use IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef instead of its current type.
targets.adoption_evidence: Before: `torch::headeronly::HeaderOnlyArrayRef<int64_t> dims) {` — merged: `torch::headeronly::IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef dims) {`. The dims parameter now uses IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef, which is what the maintainer asked for.
targets.stage3_reason: Swapping `torch::headeronly::HeaderOnlyArrayRef<int64_t> dims` for the `IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef` alias names the same type, so it only changes style. The merged code made the swap, but behavior is unchanged and there is no defect.
